confidence_notes: Restaurant and coffee anchors rest on aggregated 2026 Tokyo averages from Numbeo-derived and cost-of-living sites (about JPY 1,200 for an inexpensive meal, JPY 530-585 for a cappuccino, JPY 550-600 for a draft beer, JPY 7,000-8,000 for a three-course meal for two). The JPY-to-USD conversion assumes roughly JPY 150-155 per USD. Cocktail and wine anchors are weaker: they are estimated from general Tokyo bar and restaurant knowledge and kept in a consistent relationship to the beer anchor, with no direct price search. Hostel and hotel anchors are holistic model estimates from general knowledge and the July 2026 peak-season context, not from live booking pages or current listings. The accommodation range is wide, especially for the 3-star hotel. The FX observation is the RBA USD-per-AUD rate of 0.6720 for 18 November 2026. It was reported in a search result attributed to the RBA exchange-rates overview page, and I did not directly confirm the RBA table, so the provenance is secondary.
comparable_city_reasoning: No comparable city was used. Food and drink anchors come from Tokyo-specific aggregated price averages. Accommodation anchors come from a holistic model estimate for Tokyo as a large, high-demand Japanese city, with the July 2026 pricing window taken into account.
